faq.q: Can I charter either boat for a full day?

faq.q: Where do these boats depart from?

data.body_html:
Choosing between a Pershing 46 vs Sunseeker Predator 55 Marbella charter comes down to speed versus space. The Pershing 46 is a sleek, fast sports yacht, while the Predator 55 offers a larger, more luxurious deck for socialising. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include all essentials, but their characters differ. This face-off breaks down speed, capacity, and cost so you can pick the right boat for your day on the Costa del Sol.

Specifications at a Glance

The Pershing 46 measures 14 metres and holds up to 10 passengers. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is 17 metres long and accommodates 12 guests. Both are built for Mediterranean cruising, but the Pershing 46 leans into performance, while the Predator 55 prioritises comfort and deck space.

Speed and Performance

The Pershing 46 hits 45 knots, making it one of the fastest yachts in its class. The Sunseeker Predator 55 tops out at 38 knots. If you want to feel the wind and cover distance quickly, the Pershing 46 is your boat. For a more relaxed cruise with stability, the Predator 55 is ideal. Both handle the Marbella coastline well, but the Pershing 46 is built for thrill-seekers.

Deck Space and Comfort

The Predator 55 offers a larger aft deck and sunbathing area, perfect for groups. The Pershing 46 has a sportier, more compact layout. On the Predator 55, you can host up to 12 guests with ease. The Pershing 46 suits smaller, more intimate parties. Both have shaded areas and comfortable seating, but the Predator 55 wins on space.

Charter Pricing

The Pershing 46 costs €749 for 2 hours, €1,249 for 4 hours, €1,699 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. The Sunseeker Predator 55 requires a custom quote via WhatsApp. Both prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. For a fixed-price option, the Pershing 46 is straightforward. The Predator 55 offers flexibility for longer or bespoke charters.

Best Uses

Choose the Pershing 46 for a fast, adrenaline-filled trip to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Opt for the Predator 55 for a leisurely day cruising past the Golden Mile or anchoring off Estepona. Both boats are great for sunset trips from Puerto Banús, but the Predator 55 has more room for dining and dancing.

Which Should You Book?

If speed and a sporty feel are your priority, book the Pershing 46. If you value space and luxury for a larger group, the Sunseeker Predator 55 is better. Both deliver a premium Marbella experience. For more options, explore our full boat rental Marbella fleet.
